body.en: Asokamitran was a well-known Tamil writer who worked at Gemini Studios in Madras in the 1950s. Poets and Pancakes is taken from his book My Years with Boss, a humorous memoir of those years. Gemini Studios was founded and run by S. S. Vasan, whom everyone called the Boss. The *author*'s own job was to cut out newspaper clippings and file them, which others thought was doing nothing.

points.en: Source: My Years with Boss, a memoir

body.en: *Pancake* was the brand name of the make-up material that Gemini Studios bought in huge quantities. The make-up department, upstairs, looked like a hair-cutting salon, with large mirrors and hot, bright lights on every side. Its staff came from many regions, a Bengali, a Maharashtrian, a Kannadiga from Dharwar, an Andhra, a Madras Indian Christian, an Anglo-Burmese and local Tamils, so the author jokes that it was a fine example of national integration.
